title: Custom development
description: No recycled templates. The structure and features come from what your business actually needs.

title: Responsive on every device
description: Tested from 320px phones to wide desktops — no broken layouts, no horizontal scrolling, no unreadable text.

title: Modern, maintainable stack
description: React, Laravel and MySQL. Current tools another developer can pick up and continue without a rewrite.

title: Business-focused
description: The goal is not a website. It is more enquiries, fewer manual hours, or clearer data — decided before we start.

title: Secure by default
description: Validated input, hashed passwords, protected admin routes, CSRF and injection protection as standard.

title: Scalable architecture
description: Built so more products, users and features can be added later without starting again.

title: Clear communication
description: Plain-language updates, a written scope, and a fixed quotation before any work begins.

title: Post-launch support
description: Support after handover, plus optional maintenance for updates, backups and improvements.
